offline.banner: You're offline. Lists show the last saved copy. Payments, check-in, check-out, postings and night audit are paused until you reconnect.

auth.linkInvalid: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email.

fields.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
fields.name: Your name

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.sharedDevice: This is a shared device (signs out after 30 minutes without use)

signUp.title: Create your hotel account
signUp.intro: You will be the owner. You can add rooms, rates and staff after confirming your email.
signUp.checkEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in. The link expires in 24 hours.

verify.done: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email and we will send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password is changed and you are signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.

mfa.title: Enter your sign-in code
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Hotel Platform.
mfa.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step sign-in. Each works once.
mfa.codeFormat: Enter the 6 digits from the app
mfa.useRecovery: Lost your phone? Use a recovery code
mfa.setUpIntro: Your role needs a code from an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) each time you sign in.
mfa.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.recoveryShown: If you lose your phone, each code lets you sign in once. Write them down or print them now: they are shown only this time.

pin.title: Switch user
pin.notShared: PIN switching works on shared devices a manager has signed in. Sign in with your password here.
pin.sharedHere: This is a shared device. Staff can switch in with their PIN.

setPin.title: Set my PIN
setPin.intro: Use your PIN to switch in quickly on shared front-desk tablets. Avoid easy PINs like 123456.

form.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. If it keeps happening, quote reference {{requestId}}.
